{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tinn'lyi''' were the natives of the [[Tinn'lyi Islands]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corsin/Legends|Corsin]], formed into a nation. The Tinn'lyi worked with the native [[selligore]] [[Species/Legends|species]], a large trunked creature.<ref name="COG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
